craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra-adbhuta of tended glory through impurity — the Lord in wandering (v14 absent in data too: edition numbering gap, not a defect; L4 follows the L3 set). Jewel-near + timber-clods kept raw per UNC (kāṣṭaloṣṭavat); five-coursed. Rejected: (a) clods→dust → killed raw. Read aloud: THUS-ev-er-NEAR … LIKE-tim-ber AND-clods.

lines: Thus ever near, five-coursed, known in order — wish-jewel;
that, from unknowing — like timber and clods.
l4.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ sadā saṃnihitaḥ pañcavāhavidhiḥ | cintāmaṇir asāv ajñānāt kāṣṭaloṣṭavat

reads_against.argmap: What jewel from ignorance? → Present course known as jewel; ignorance wood-clod.
c1_essence: Tended means; Lord tends; release-glory proceeds.
God's five, self's five; delusion the difference.
Expansion sung capable; contraction called wanderer.
Withdrawn grace in oneness; manifesting named veiling.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra of tended glory; adbhuta of actor-assumed stages; adbhuta of shining-impure; karuṇa-vīra of confessed Lord; vīra of mirrored acts; vīra of named states; adbhuta of willing māyā; karuṇa-adbhuta of graced veiling; adbhuta of jewel-near-yet-clod
